marketLayer.title: US & HK Tech Infrastructure & AI Capex
marketLayer.fact: US chipmakers and HK-listed tech giants report sustained surge in data center capital expenditures, alongside double-digit growth in cloud business revenues.
marketLayer.inference: High capital spending reinforces upstream semiconductor valuation multiples while putting pressure on software firms to accelerate AI monetization.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential delays in end-user enterprise AI adoption and capital efficiency scrutiny from institutional investors.

marketLayer.title: HK-Listed E-Commerce & Cross-Border Logistics
marketLayer.fact: Major Chinese e-commerce platforms show steady GMV stabilization due to aggressive summer promotional campaigns and expanded overseas shipping networks.
marketLayer.inference: Domestic margin compression will be partially offset by high-margin cross-border logistics growth, favoring integrated platform plays.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving overseas tariff policies and persistent price-war pressures in the domestic retail landscape.

marketLayer.title: US Monetary Policy Outlook & HK Banking Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: US economic data reflects moderating inflation alongside stable payroll numbers, sustaining market pricing for gradual rate adjustments.
marketLayer.inference: HIBOR is expected to stay range-bound, preserving net interest margins for major HK banks while offering relief to property developer financing costs.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Re-acceleration of global inflation energy spikes that could alter the central bank easing trajectory.
